cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(TheCadPlaneGcs LANGUAGES CXX)
endif()
# Standalone PlaneGCS; only this private implementation requires C++20.
set(THECAD_SOLVER_DEPS_PREFIX "$ENV{LOCALAPPDATA}/TheCAD/dev/sketch-solver" CACHE PATH "Isolated Eigen/Boost header dependency prefix")
find_path(THECAD_EIGEN_INCLUDE Eigen/Core HINTS "${THECAD_SOLVER_DEPS_PREFIX}/Library/include/eigen3" REQUIRED)
find_path(THECAD_BOOST_INCLUDE boost/version.hpp HINTS "${THECAD_SOLVER_DEPS_PREFIX}/Library/include" REQUIRED)
add_library(thecad_planegcs SHARED Constraints.cpp GCS.cpp Geo.cpp SubSystem.cpp qp_eq.cpp)
set_target_properties(thecad_planegcs PROPERTIES AUTOMOC OFF CXX_STANDARD 20 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>")
target_compile_definitions(thecad_planegcs PRIVATE THECAD_PLANEGCS_BUILD PUBLIC EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
target_include_directories(thecad_planegcs PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_include_directories(thecad_planegcs SYSTEM PUBLIC "${THECAD_EIGEN_INCLUDE}" "${THECAD_BOOST_INCLUDE}")
if(MSVC)
 target_compile_options(thecad_planegcs PRIVATE /bigobj /utf-8 /permissive- /wd4251 /wd4275)
endif()
